newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 up at 41.20 to the dollar in the kerb market on Sunday may open stable on Monday amid a renewed demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said low dollars rates were likely to attract some buying and keep the rupee steady around the current levels.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate was unchanged at 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar set on October 22.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 3.10 percent compared to Saturday's 3.50 percent.
